title: Refunds and Service Credits on Harborline Account Credit
content:
# Refunds and service credits on account credit

> Harborline Customer Accounts

## Clause

A refund is credited to account credit when the product rule allows it and the customer elects credit, or always when the refunded charge was itself paid from credit. A refund may be credited only while the account status is active, recovery hold or locked, and a refund due on a closed account goes to the original payment method instead. The credited amount equals the refunded amount of the product charge, unchanged by any tier figure. Each refunded product charge is credited only once. A contractual service credit issued by a product rule, such as a hosting uptime credit, is added for exactly the amount that rule computes and is likewise posted once per product credit line.

Each refund credit entry carries the category and the reference number of the refunded product charge; each service credit entry carries the issuing category and the reference number of the product credit line.

## When a refund lands on account credit

| Refunded charge paid from | Product rule allows credit and customer elects it | Account status | Where the refund goes |
|---|---|---|---|
| account credit | either | active, recovery hold or locked | account credit |
| card or PayPal | yes | active, recovery hold or locked | account credit |
| any | any | closed | the original payment method |

## Points of judgement

- **Does a reseller tier discount change the amount credited?** No. The credited amount equals the refunded amount of the product charge, unchanged by any tier figure.
- **Can the same refunded charge be credited twice?** No. A charge reference that already carries a refund entry receives no second one.
- **Is a locked account still credited?** Yes; locked is one of the statuses in which a refund may be credited.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A hosting uptime credit computed by the hosting rule at $6.37 is added for exactly $6.37, once for that product credit line.
